cb684ba6295232a35f401cc1e546338b4050e1ef.notes: Despite being named X/Y, sample values (e.g. -7.36, 54.18) are decimal-degree longitude/latitude within UK/NI range, not BNG, so mapped to lon/lat rather than easting/northing. Opening hours are split across seven separate day-of-week columns (Monday..Sunday) with no single opening_hours column, so opening_hours is left unmapped; a reviewer may want a bespoke step to combine these.
